description:
## Problem

Simulation campaigns run for hours (3.5+ hours observed for moderate-mode Phase 1/3). Currently:
- Results are written only after ALL SNR points for a curve complete
- Progress is only visible via ephemeral stderr prints with no timestamps or ETA
- If a long run crashes at the last SNR point, all prior results are lost
- The custom `run_product_sim` loop in `grand_phase1_sims.rs` duplicates `SimulationRunner` logic because `TurboDecoder` doesn't implement `IterativeSoftDecoder`

## Changes

### 1. Incremental CSV append
Write each completed SNR point to the output CSV immediately via `OpenOptions::append`. Final `write_to` at end overwrites with clean complete file.

### 2. JSONL progress log
Write `.progress.jsonl` alongside CSV with adaptive wall-clock updates (10s first, then 60s). Per-point completion entries. Enables monitoring from external tools.

### 3. Resumable runs
On startup, parse existing CSV. Skip SNR points that already have ≥ `min_errors` frame errors. Print `RESUMED` to stderr.

### 4. Closure-based simulation runner
New `SimulationRunner::run_with_decoder(encoder, decode_fn: FnMut, channel, config)` that accepts any decoder via closure. Eliminates the duplicate `run_product_sim` loop. Requires `impl From<TurboDecoderResult> for DecoderResult`.

### 5. Improved stderr progress
Per-point: `[3.0 dB] DONE: BLER=2.64e-3 (100 errors / 37892 frames) in 4m23s — ETA 12m for 2 remaining`
Intra-point (adaptive): `[3.5 dB] progress: 8432/~100K frames, 12 errors, ~47m remaining`

### 6. Update example runners
Remove custom product sim loop from `grand_phase1_sims.rs`. Set `output_path` on all configs.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] Each SNR point appended to CSV immediately on completion
- [ ] JSONL progress file written with adaptive wall-clock entries
- [ ] Resumable: re-running with existing CSV skips completed points
- [ ] `run_with_decoder` closure API replaces custom `run_product_sim` loop
- [ ] `run_product_sim` removed from `grand_phase1_sims.rs`
- [ ] Stderr shows wall-clock elapsed and ETA per point
- [ ] All existing tests pass unchanged
- [ ] New tests: incremental CSV, resume, JSONL, closure runner equivalence

## Files

- `crates/gf2-coding/src/simulation.rs` — core changes
- `crates/gf2-coding/src/product/mod.rs` — `From<TurboDecoderResult> for DecoderResult`
- `crates/gf2-coding/examples/grand_phase1_sims.rs` — use closure runner
- `crates/gf2-coding/examples/grand_phase3_sim.rs` — ensure output_path set
title: Incremental simulation logging and per-point result persistence
